name: ipc_lookup
description: Look up one International Patent Classification (IPC) symbol via WIPO IPCPUB — its English/French title, structural breakdown (section/class/subclass/group/subgroup) and whether it is a currently valid classification. Give "symbol" as a subclass ("A01N") or a full group/subgroup ("A61K 31/00"). IPC only — the related-but-different CPC scheme (EPO/USPTO) is not covered here.

name: ipc_children
description: List the IPC symbols directly classified under one IPC symbol — the main groups under a subclass, or the subgroups under a group — with each child's title. Give "symbol" as a subclass ("A01N") or a group ("A61K 31/00").

symbol.description: IPC symbol to list the children of, e.g. "A01N" or "A61K 31/00".

name: ipc_search
description: Find IPC symbols whose title text matches a keyword, e.g. "vaccine" or "solar cell". Returns matching symbols with their canonical ids — call ipc_lookup on a hit for its full title and validity.

query.description: Keyword or short phrase to search IPC titles for, e.g. "vaccine".

name: ipc_versions
description: List International Patent Classification (IPC) edition dates WIPO currently publishes, with the current (in-force) and latest (published, may be future-dated) editions named.
